entities.summary: Saint Vincent de Paul Chapel is a Catholic church in Paris, France's 6th arrondissement, 95 rue de Sèvres. It is the church of the Congregation of the Mission, also known as the Lazarists, founded by Saint Vincent de Paul (1581–1660). His remains are venerated there in a silver reliquary over the altar, above the main altar.
